prompt: Build the Chinese internet meme character 大笑奶龙 (Laughing Nailong, also called 奶蛙) in 3D with three.js from memory, as it appears in the meme. No reference image is provided. Task (3D, static, from memory): write an HTML page that builds the character from code and renders it from your reference camera. For this static task, render(t) may ignore t. three.js contract: - The harness injects an import map for three.js r187. Import from 'three' and from 'three/addons/'; the only addons available are 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ConvexGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricFunctions.js', 'three/addons/geometries/ParametricGeometry.js', 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js', 'three/addons/math/ConvexHull.js', 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'. Use one
html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-Hans">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=240, initial-scale=1">
<title>大笑奶龙</title>
<style>
  html, body { width: 240px; height: 240px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 240px; height: 240px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf5f0e7);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-1.80, 1.80, 1.80, -1.80, 0.1, 30);
ref.position.set(0.93, 0.91, 7.3);
ref.lookAt(0.11, 0.275, 0);

const makeMaterial = (color, roughness = 0.68) =>
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color, roughness });

const skin = makeMaterial(0xffce26, 0.62);
const belly = makeMaterial(0xffeb8a);
const orange = makeMaterial(0xf8a12a);
const eyeInk = makeMaterial(0x41210d);
const noseInk = makeMaterial(0xbe7921);
const dimpleInk = makeMaterial(0xe4a026);
const teeth = makeMaterial(0xfff7df, 0.47);
const tonguePink = makeMaterial(0xf26b78, 0.52);
const tongueLine = makeMaterial(0xcb4658);
const sphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 28);
const v3 = (x, y, z) => new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

function group(parent, name, x = 0, y = 0, z = 0) {
  const object = new THREE.Group();
  object.name = name;
  object.position.set(x, y, z);
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

function mesh(parent, name, geometry, material, shadows = true) {
  const object = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  object.name = name;
  object.castShadow = shadows;
  parent.add(object);
  return object;
}

function ball(parent, name, material, x, y, z, sx, sy, sz, shadows = true) {
  const object = mesh(parent, name, sphere, material, shadows);
  object.position.set(x, y, z);
  object.scale.set(sx, sy, sz);
  return object;
}

function ringSurface(rows, colors) {
  const width = rows[0].length;
  const positions = [];
  const indices = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    for (const p of row) positions.push(p.x, p.y, p.z);
  }
  for (let j = 0; j < rows.length - 1; j++) {
    for (let i = 0; i < width; i++) {
      const next = (i + 1) % width;
      const a = j * width + i;
      const b = (j + 1) * width + i;
      const c = (j + 1) * width + next;
      const d = j * width + next;
      indices.push(a, b, c, a, c, d);
    }
  }
  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  if (colors) geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return geometry;
}

function roundedSweep(parent, name, material, points, radii, flatten = 1, shadows = true) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
  const steps = 42;
  const sides = 24;
  const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(steps, false);
  const rows = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const t = j / steps;
    const center = curve.getPointAt(t);
    const k = t * (radii.length - 1);
    const i = Math.floor(k);
    const radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[i], radii[Math.min(i + 1, radii.length - 1)], k - i);
    const row = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < sides; n++) {
      const angle = -2 * Math.PI * n / sides;
      row.push(center.clone()
        .addScaledVector(frames.normals[j], radius * Math.cos(angle))
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j], radius * flatten * Math.sin(angle)));
    }
    rows.push(row);
  }
  return mesh(parent, name, ringSurface(rows), material, shadows);
}

function stroke(parent, name, material, points, radius) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
  const steps = 32;
  const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(steps, false);
  const rows = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= steps; j++) {
    const t = j / steps;
    const p = curve.getPointAt(t);
    const r = radius * Math.pow(Math.max(0.001, Math.sin(Math.PI * t)), 0.36);
    const row = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      const angle = -2 * Math.PI * i / 12;
      row.push(p.clone()
        .addScaledVector(frames.normals[j], r * Math.cos(angle))
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[j], r * Math.sin(angle)));
    }
    rows.push(row);
  }
  return mesh(parent, name, ringSurface(rows), material, false);
}

const nailong = group(scene, 'character-laughing-nailong');
const body = group(nailong, 'body');

const torsoGeometry = sphere.clone();
const torsoPositions = torsoGeometry.getAttribute('position');
for (let i = 0; i < torsoPositions.count; i++) {
  const x = torsoPositions.getX(i);
  const y = torsoPositions.getY(i);
  const z = torsoPositions.getZ(i);
  torsoPositions.setXYZ(i, 0.823 * (1 - 0.18 * y) * x,
    -0.365 + 0.902 * y, 0.655 * (1 - 0.07 * y) * z - 0.045 * y);
}
torsoGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
mesh(body, 'pear-shaped torso', torsoGeometry, skin);

function torsoFront(x, y) {
  const h = (y + 0.365) / 0.902;
  const u = x / (0.823 * (1 - 0.18 * h));
  return 0.655 * (1 - 0.07 * h) * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - h * h - u * u)) - 0.045 * h;
}

const bellyRows = [];
for (let j = 0; j <= 20; j++) {
  const r = Math.max(0.0001, j / 20);
  const row = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    const a = 2 * Math.PI * i / 80;
    const h = r * Math.sin(a);
    const x = 0.61 * r * Math.cos(a) * (1 - 0.17 * h);
    const y = -0.455 + 0.655 * h;
    row.push(v3(x, y, torsoFront(x, y) + 0.006 + 0.009 * (1 - r * r)));
  }
  bellyRows.push(row);
}
mesh(body, 'butter-yellow belly', ringSurface(bellyRows), belly, false);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const foot = group(nailong, side < 0 ? 'left-foot' : 'right-foot',
    0.443 * side, -1.107, 0.212);
  foot.rotation.y = side * 0.24;
  ball(foot, 'ankle', skin, 0, 0.133, -0.095, 0.263, 0.25, 0.248);
  ball(foot, 'wide foot', skin, 0, -0.022, 0.09, 0.334, 0.19, 0.356);
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    ball(foot, 'toe', skin, i * 0.159, -0.046, 0.30 - Math.abs(i) * 0.037,
      0.115, 0.124, 0.151);
  }
}

const tail = group(nailong, 'tail');
roundedSweep(tail, 'curled tail', skin, [
  v3(0.04, -0.75, -0.36),
  v3(0.29, -0.86, -0.65),
  v3(0.66, -0.93, -0.91),
  v3(1.10, -0.91, -0.94),
  v3(1.43, -0.78, -0.83),
  v3(1.55, -0.65, -0.73)
], [0.282, 0.268, 0.218, 0.158, 0.089, 0.002]);

function plate(parent, x, y, z, pitch, yaw, width, height, length) {
  const spine = group(parent, 'soft orange dorsal spike', x, y, z);
  spine.rotation.set(pitch, yaw, 0);
  const rows = [];
  for (let j = 0; j <= 18; j++) {
    const t = j / 18;
    const shape = Math.max(0.002, Math.pow(1 - t, 0.72));
    const row = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
      const a = -i * 2 * Math.PI / 32;
      row.push(v3(width * shape * Math.cos(a),
        height * t, length * shape * Math.sin(a) - length * 0.44 * t));
    }
    rows.push(row);
  }
  mesh(spine, 'rounded spike', ringSurface(rows), orange);
}

plate(body, 0, 0.23, -0.49, -0.93, 0, 0.137, 0.196, 0.175);
plate(body, 0, -0.085, -0.603, -1.28, 0, 0.14, 0.222, 0.17);
plate(body, 0.018, -0.42, -0.624, -1.50, 0, 0.125, 0.183, 0.154);
plate(tail, 0.43, -0.69, -0.783, -0.19, -0.94, 0.092, 0.182, 0.127);
plate(tail, 0.78, -0.751, -0.942, -0.13, -1.50, 0.085, 0.15, 0.11);
plate(tail, 1.11, -0.786, -0.947, -0.08, -1.72, 0.058, 0.112, 0.085);
plate(tail, 1.34, -0.749, -0.873, 0.18, -1.98, 0.042, 0.071, 0.063);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const left = side < 0;
  const arm = group(nailong, left ? 'left-arm' : 'right-arm');
  const y = left ? -0.342 : -0.157;
  roundedSweep(arm, 'bent arm', skin, [
    v3(side * 0.581, 0.105, 0.135),
    v3(side * 0.721, -0.026, 0.264),
    v3(side * 0.773, y + 0.01, 0.458),
    v3(side * 0.643, y - 0.034, 0.579),
    v3(side * 0.505, y - 0.013, 0.653)
  ], [0.147, 0.175, 0.151, 0.122, 0.081]);
  const hand = group(arm, left ? 'left-hand' : 'right-hand',
    side * 0.484, y - 0.016, 0.658);
  hand.rotation.z = left ? -0.27 : 0.35;
  hand.rotation.y = side * 0.25;
  ball(hand, 'palm', skin, 0, 0, 0, 0.155, 0.117, 0.111);
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    ball(hand, 'finger', skin, -side * (0.107 - Math.abs(i) * 0.018),
      i * 0.053, 0.02, 0.086, 0.045, 0.072);
  }
}

const head = group(nailong, 'head', 0, 1.009, 0.031);
head.rotation.set(-0.035, 0.023, 0.053);
const rx = 1.115;
const ry = 0.803;
const rz = 0.809;
const mouthCenter = -0.273;

function headFront(x, y) {
  return rz * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - (x / rx) ** 2 - (y / ry) ** 2));
}

const outline = new THREE.Shape();
outline.moveTo(0.829, -0.055);
outline.bezierCurveTo(0.782, 0.045, 0.458, -0.045, 0.194, -0.063);
outline.bezierCurveTo(0.02, -0.079, -0.124, -0.077, -0.291, -0.058);
outline.bezierCurveTo(-0.526, -0.035, -0.77, 0.025, -0.834, -0.07);
outline.bezierCurveTo(-0.901, -0.182, -0.667, -0.498, -0.436, -0.601);
outline.bezierCurveTo(-0.225, -0.702, 0.164, -0.717, 0.402, -0.617);
outline.bezierCurveTo(0.625, -0.522, 0.886, -0.171, 0.829, -0.055);

const boundary = outline.getSpacedPoints(144).slice(0, -1);
const edge = boundary.map(p => {
  const dx = p.x;
  const dy = p.y - mouthCenter;
  const a = (dx / rx) ** 2 + (dy / ry) ** 2;
  const b = 2 * mouthCenter * dy / (ry * ry);
  const c = (mouthCenter / ry) ** 2 - 1;
  const s = (-b + Math.sqrt(b * b - 4 * a * c)) / (2 * a);
  return new THREE.Vector2(dx * s, mouthCenter + dy * s);
});

const headRows = [];
for (let i = 0; i <= 29; i++) {
  const t = Math.sin(i / 29 * Math.PI / 2);
  headRows.push(boundary.map((p, j) => {
    const x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(p.x, edge[j].x, t);
    const y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(p.y, edge[j].y, t);
    return v3(x, y, i === 29 ? 0 : headFront(x, y));
  }));
}
for (let i = 1; i <= 28; i++) {
  const a = i / 28 * (Math.PI / 2 - 0.00003);
  headRows.push(edge.map(p => v3(p.x * Math.cos(a), p.y * Math.cos(a), -rz * Math.sin(a))));
}
const headGeometry = ringSurface(headRows);
const headPositions = headGeometry.getAttribute('position');
const headNormals = headGeometry.getAttribute('normal');
for (let i = 0; i < headPositions.count; i++) {
  const n = v3(headPositions.getX(i) / (rx * rx),
    headPositions.getY(i) / (ry * ry), headPositions.getZ(i) / (rz * rz)).normalize();
  headNormals.setXYZ(i, n.x, n.y, n.z);
}
mesh(head, 'round yellow head and cheeks', headGeometry, skin);
plate(head, 0, 0.705, -0.263, -0.49, 0, 0.115, 0.221, 0.173);
plate(head, 0, 0.52, -0.56, -0.86, 0, 0.123, 0.211, 0.15);
plate(head, 0, 0.21, -0.765, -1.35, 0, 0.124, 0.19, 0.151);
plate(head, 0, -0.147, -0.77, -1.68, 0, 0.113, 0.168, 0.14);

const mouth = group(head, 'open-laughing-mouth');
const mouthRows = [];
const mouthColors = [];
const innerDark = new THREE.Color(0x351016);
const lowerDark = new THREE.Color(0x73232b);
const lipSkin = skin.color;
const lipInner = new THREE.Color(0xbf6d24);
const layers = [
  0.0001, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.50, 0.625, 0.75, 0.85, 0.91, 0.95, 0.968, 0.982, 1
];
for (const r of layers) {
  const row = [];
  for (const p of boundary) {
    const x = p.x * r;
    const y = mouthCenter + (p.y - mouthCenter) * r;
    const edgeZ = headFront(p.x, p.y);
    const lower = THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(-p.y, 0.15, 0.66);
    let z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(0.282, edgeZ - 0.092, (r / 0.95) ** 2.35);
    let color = innerDark.clone().lerp(lowerDark, lower * r * 0.76);
    if (r === 0.968) {
      z = edgeZ - 0.061;
      color.lerp(lipInner, 0.29);
    }
    if (r === 0.982) {
      z = edgeZ - 0.026;
      color = lipInner.clone().lerp(lipSkin, 0.42);
    }
    if (r === 1) {
      z = edgeZ;
      color = lipSkin;
    }
    row.push(v3(x, y, z));
    mouthColors.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
  }
  mouthRows.push(row);
}
mesh(mouth, 'recessed mouth and rounded lip', ringSurface(mouthRows, mouthColors),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: 0.71 }), false);

const tongue = group(mouth, 'tongue', 0.032, -0.474, 0.518);
tongue.rotation.z = -0.055;
const tongueGeometry = sphere.clone();
const tonguePositions = tongueGeometry.getAttribute('position');
for (let i = 0; i < tonguePositions.count; i++) {
  const x = tonguePositions.getX(i);
  const y = tonguePositions.getY(i);
  const z = tonguePositions.getZ(i);
  const notch = 0.021 * Math.exp(-x * x / 0.039) * Math.max(0, y) ** 2;
  tonguePositions.setXYZ(i, x * 0.393, y * 0.128 - notch, z * 0.105 + 0.041 * y);
}
tongueGeometry.computeVertexNormals();
mesh(tongue, 'pink tongue', tongueGeometry, tonguePink, false);
stroke(tongue, 'tongue crease', tongueLine, [
  v3(-0.017, 0.081, 0.093),
  v3(-0.012, 0.064, 0.104),
  v3(-0.003, 0.042, 0.113),
  v3(0.008, 0.022, 0.111)
], 0.006, false);

const upperTeeth = group(mouth, 'upper-teeth');
const toothGeometry = new RoundedBoxGeometry(0.177, 0.154, 0.104, 5, 0.043);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const tooth = mesh(upperTeeth, 'little front tooth', toothGeometry, teeth, false);
  tooth.position.set(side * 0.094, -0.106, 0.751);
  tooth.rotation.set(0.12, side * 0.085, side * 0.068);
}

function onFace(x, y, offset = 0.013) {
  return v3(x, y, headFront(x, y) + offset);
}

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const eye = group(head, side < 0 ? 'left-eye' : 'right-eye');
  const lift = side < 0 ? -0.004 : 0.016;
  stroke(eye, 'squeezed-shut eye', eyeInk, [
    onFace(side * 0.178, 0.198 + lift, 0.006),
    onFace(side * 0.268, 0.281 + lift),
    onFace(side * 0.389, 0.306 + lift),
    onFace(side * 0.515, 0.267 + lift),
    onFace(side * 0.612, 0.176 + lift, 0.005)
  ], 0.033);
  const cheek = group(head, side < 0 ? 'left-cheek' : 'right-cheek');
  stroke(cheek, 'smile dimple', dimpleInk, [
    onFace(side * 0.836, 0.064, 0.004),
    onFace(side * 0.881, 0.043, 0.009),
    onFace(side * 0.909, -0.007, 0.008),
    onFace(side * 0.899, -0.054, 0.004)
  ], 0.013);
}

const nose = group(head, 'nose');
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const p = onFace(0.086 * side, 0.094, 0.002);
  const nostril = ball(nose, 'small nostril', noseInk, p.x, p.y, p.z,
    0.029, 0.019, 0.009, false);
  nostril.rotation.z = 0.38 * side;
  nostril.rotation.y = 0.07 * side;
}

const floor = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100),
  new THREE.ShadowMaterial({ color: 0x6b492d, opacity: 0.17 }));
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
floor.position.y = -1.318;
floor.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(floor);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff9ec, 0xe3d2b4, 1.75));
const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff5e4, 2.06);
key.position.set(-3.8, 5.9, 4.7);
key.castShadow = true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
key.shadow.camera.left = -3.1;
key.shadow.camera.right = 3.1;
key.shadow.camera.top = 3.1;
key.shadow.camera.bottom = -3.1;
key.shadow.camera.near = 0.3;
key.shadow.camera.far = 16;
key.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
key.shadow.bias = -0.0002;
key.shadow.radius = 3;
scene.add(key);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe3edff, 0.56);
fill.position.set(4.5, 2.1, 2.8);
scene.add(fill);
const back = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffedce, 1.12);
back.position.set(1.0, 4.1, -4.7);
scene.add(back);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

const characters = [nailong];
render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters, render, ready: true };
</script>
</body>
